preguntaEn: IF THE SPRING BRAKE ARE ON, WHEN SHOULD YOU PUSH THE BRAKE PEDAL?
opcionesEn: ONLY WHEN DRIVING DOWN A HILL.
ONLY ON THE SLIPPERY ROAD
NEVER.

preguntaEn: WITH AIR BRAKE VEHICLE, THE PARKING BRAKES SHOULD BE USED:
opcionesEn: WHENEVER YOU LEAVE THE VEHICLE UNATTENDED.
AS LITTLE AS POSSIBLE.
ONLY DURING PRE- AND POST TRIP INSPECTIONS.

preguntaEn: THE MOST IMPORTANT THING TO DO WHEN A LOW AIR PRESSURE WARNING COMES ON IS:
opcionesEn: UPSHIFT.
DOWNSHIFT.
STOP AND SAFELY PARK AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

preguntaEn: DURING NORMAL DRIVING, SPRING BRAKES ARE USUALLY HELD BACK BY:
opcionesEn: BOLTS.
AIR PRESSURE.
SPRING PRESSURE.

preguntaEn: IF YOU ARE DRIVING DOWN A STEEP DOWNGRADE AND YOU HAVE REACHED YOUR ‘’SAFE’’ SPEED OF 40 MPH YOU WOULD APPLY THE SERVICE BRAKES UNTIL YOUR SPEED DROPS TO ___ MPH.
THERE ARE TWO THINGS THAT A DRIVER CAN DO TO PREVENT A ROLLOVER. THEY ARE: (1) KEEP THE CARGO AS CLOSE TO THE GROUND AS POSSIBLE; AND (2):
opcionesEn: GO SLOW AROUND TURNS.
KEEP BOTH HANDS FIRMLY ON THE STEERING WHEEL.
MAKE SURE THAT THE BRAKES ARE PROPERLY ADJUSTED.

preguntaEn: EMERGENCY CONTROLLED BRAKING IS WHEN YOU:
opcionesEn: APPLY THE BRAKES AS HARD AS YOU CAN WITHOUT LOCKING THE WHEELS.
BRAKE AS HARD AS YOU CAN, RELEASE THE BRAKES WHEN WHEELS LOCKING, BRAKES BACK ON AGAIN WHEN THE WHEELS START ROLLING.
APPLY THE HAND VALVE FOR ONE SECOND, THEN PUSH HARD ON THE BRAKES.

preguntaEn: WHEN BRAKES ARE APPLIED THE BRAKE SHOES (OR LININGS) WILL ALIGN TO PRESS AGAINST THE:
opcionesEn: BRAKE DRUM OR DISC.
SLACK ADJUSTER.
S-CAM.

preguntaEn: THE STOP LIGHT SWITCH:
opcionesEn: TELLS YOU WHEN THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM IS LOW ON AIR PRESSURE.
TELLS YOU WHEN YOU NEED TO USE YOUR EMERGENCY BRAKES.
TURNS ON YOUR BRAKE LIGHTS TO WARN DRIVERS BEHIND YOU.

preguntaEn: IF YOUR VEHICLE HAS AN ALCOHOL EVAPORATOR, EVERY DAY DURING COLD WEATHER YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: CHECK AND FILL THE ALCOHOL LEVEL.
CHANGE THE ALCOHOL FROM A NEW BOTTLE.
CHECK THE OIL FOR ALCOHOL CONTENT.

preguntaEn: THE BRAKE PEDAL IN AN AIR BRAKE SYSTEM:
opcionesEn: CONTOLS THE SPEED OF THE AIR COMPRESSOR.
CONTROLS THE AIR PRESSURE APPLIED TO PUT ON THE BRAKES.
IS CONNECTED TO SLACK ADJUSTERS BY A SERIES OF RODS AND LINKAGES.

preguntaEn: IT IS NOT SAFE TO DRIVE A VEHICLE THAT HAS BRAKE DRUMS WITH CRACK THAT ARE LONGER THAN ______ OF THE WIDTH OF THE FRICTION AREA.
opcionesEn: ONE HALF.
ONE FOURTH.
ONE EIGHT.

preguntaEn: BEFORE DRIVING A TRUCK OR BUS WITH A DUAL AIR BRAKE SYSTEM, THE AIR PRESSURE MUS BE AT LEAST____ PSI.
AN AIR BRAKE SYSTEM IS FULLY CHARGED AT____ PSI.
A STRAIGHT TRUCK OR BUS AIR BRAKE SYSTEM SHOULD NOT LEAK AT THE RATE OF MORE THAN ______ PSI PER MINUTE WITH THE ENGINE OFF AND THE BRAKES RELEASED.
THE AIR COMPRESSOR GOVERNOR CONTROLS:
opcionesEn: THE SPEED OF THE AIR COMPRESSOR.
AIR PRESSURE APPLIED TO THE BRAKES.
WHEN AIR IS PUMPED INTO THE AIR TANKS.

preguntaEn: WHY DRAIN WATER FORM COMPRESSED AIR TANKS?
opcionesEn: THE LOW BOILING POINT OF WATER REDUCES BRAKING POWER.
WATER CAN FREEZE IN COLD WEATHER AND CAUSE BRAKE FAILURE.
WATER COOLS THE COMPRESSOR TOO MUCH.

preguntaEn: EXCESSIVE HEAT CAUSED BY USING YOUR BRAKE TOO OFTEN CAN ALSO CAUSE:
opcionesEn: MODULATING CONTROL VALVE TO WEAR OUT.
BRAKE LINES TO PLUG.
BRAKES TO FADE OR FAIL.

preguntaEn: THE AIR COMPRESSOR SHOULD STOP PUMPING AIR WHEN PRESSURE REACH____PSI.
THE AIR LOSS RATE FOR A STRAIGHT TRUCK OR BUS WITH THE ENGINE OFF AND THE BRAKES ON SHOULD NOT BE MORE THAN:
opcionesEn: 1 PSI IN ONE MINUTE.
2 PSI IN 45 SECONDS.
3 PSI IN ONE MINUTE.

preguntaEn: THE SAFETY VALVE DISCHARGE AUTOMATICALLY AT THE PRESSURE OF:
YOUR BRAKES ARE FADING WHEN:
opcionesEn: YOU HAVE TO PUSH HARDER ON THE BRAKE PEDAL TO CONTOL YOUR SPEED ON A DOWNGRADE.
LESS PRESSURE IS NEEDED ON THE BRAKE PEDARL FOR EACH STOP.
THE BRAKE PEDAL FEEL SPONGY WHEN YOU APPLY PRESSURE.

preguntaEn: IN AIR BRAKES VEHICLES, THE PARKING BRAKES SHOULD BE USED:
opcionesEn: AS LITTLE AS POSSIBLE.
ANY TIME WHEN VEHICLE IS PARKED.
TO HOLD YOUR SPEED WHEN GOING DOWNHILL.

preguntaEn: THE BRAKING POWER OG THE SPRING BRAKES:
opcionesEn: IS NOT AFFECTED BY THE CONDITION OF THE SERVICE BRAKES.
DEPENDS ON THE SERVICE BRAKES BEIGN IN ADJUSTMENT.
INCREASES WHEN THE SERVICE BRAKES ARE HOT.

preguntaEn: IF AIR PRESSURE IS NOT BUILT UP WITHIN THE CORRECT AMOUNT OF TIME, THEN:
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD BE READY TO USE YOUR PARKING BRAKES TO HELP STOP.
THE ALCOHOL CONTAINER MAY BE LOW.
YOUR AIR PRESSURE MAY DROP TOO A LOW DURING DRIVING, REQUIRING AN EMERGENCY STOP.

preguntaEn: THE SAFETY VALVE REDUCES PRESSURE AT ____ PSI?
WHEN BRAKES ARE APPLIED THE BRAKE SHOES WILL PRESS AGAINST THE:
opcionesEn: BRAKE DRUM OR DISC.
SLACK ADJUSTER.
S-CAM.

preguntaEn: THE DRIVER MUST BE ABLE TO SEE A LOW AIR PRESSURE WARNING WHICH COMES ON BEFORE PRESSURE IN THE SERVICE AIR TANKS FALLS BELOW _____ PSI.
THE PARKING OR EMERGENCY BRAKE ON A HEAVY VEHICLE CAN ONLY BE HELD IN POSITION BY SOMETHING THAT CANNOT LEAK AWAY, LIKE:
opcionesEn: SPRING PRESSURE.
AIR PRESSURE.
HYDRAULIC PRESSURE.

preguntaEn: IT IS ACCEPTED THAT TOO MUCH HEAT CAUSED BY USING YOUR BRAKES TOO OFTEN CAN ALSO CAUSE:
opcionesEn: MODULATED CONTROL VALVE TO WEAR OUT.
BRAKE LININGS TO SLIPT UP.
BRAKE TO FADE OR FAIL.

preguntaEn: A SLACK ADJUSTER PROBABLY NEEDS TO BE ADJUSTED IF IT MOVES MORE THAN_______ INCHES WHEN YOU PULL HARD ON IT?
opcionesEn: ¼.
½.

preguntaEn: MODERN AIR BRAKE SYSTEM COMBINE THREE DIFFERENT SYSTEMS. THE ARE THE SERVICE, THE PARKING AND THE ______ BRAKES.
opcionesEn: EMERGENCY.
FOOT.
S-CAM.

preguntaEn: IF YOU DO NOT HAVE AUTOMATIC TANK DRAINS, HOW OFTEN SHOULD YOU DRAIN THE OIL AND WATER FROM THE BOTTOM OF COMPRESSED AIR STORAGE TANKS?
opcionesEn: AFTER EVERY FOUR HOURS OF SERVICE.
AT THE END OF EACH DAY OF DRIVING.
ONCE A WEEK.

preguntaEn: YOUR VEHICLE HAS A DUAL AIR BRAKE SYSTEM. IF A LOW AIR PRESSURE WARNING COMES ON FOR ONLY ONE SYSTEM, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: BRING THE VEHICLE TO A SAFE STOP AND CONTINUE ONLY AFTER THE SYSTEM IS FIXED.
REDUCE YOUR SPEED, AND TEST THE REMAINING SYSTEM WHILE UNDER WAY.
REDUCE YOUR SPEED, AND DRIVE TO THE NEAREST GARAGE FOR REPAIRS.

preguntaEn: WHILE CHECKING IF THE TRAILER IS SECURELY COUPLED TO THE TRAILER THE LANDING GEARS SHOULD BE:
opcionesEn: FULLY RAISED.
SLIGHTLY RAISED.
FULLY LOWERED.

preguntaEn: IN GENERAL, THE HIGHER THE ‘’CENTER OF GRAVITY’’ OF YOUR TRUCK, THE:
opcionesEn: EASIER IT IS TO TURN AROUND CORNERS.
MORE STABLE IT IS WHEN TURNING.
EASIER IT IS TO TURN OVER.

preguntaEn: WHY SHOULD YOU BE SURE THAT THE FIFTH WHEEL PLATE IS GREASED AS REQUIRED?
opcionesEn: TO ENSURE A GOOD ELECTRICAL CONNECTION.
TO PREVENT STEERING PROBLEMS.
TO REDUCE HEAT AND NOISE.

preguntaEn: BEFORE YOU BACK UNDER A TRAILER, MAKE SURE THAT:
opcionesEn: THE TRAILER BRAKES ARE LOCKED.
THE AIR BRAKES ARE OFF.
THE AIR SUPPLY KNOB IS IN.

preguntaEn: IF THE SPRING BRAKES DON’T RELEASE WHEN YOU PUSH THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY VALVE, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: CHECK AIR LINE CONNECTIONS.
CROSS THE AIR LINES.
CHECK THE ELECTRICAL SERVICE CABLE.

preguntaEn: AFTER CONNECTING THE AIR LINES BUT BEFORE BACKING UNDER THE TRAILER, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: SUPPLY AIR TO THE TRAILER SYSTEM, THEN PULL OUT THE AIR SUPPLY KNOB.
MAKE SURE THAT THE TRAILER BRAKES ARE OFF.
WALK ARROUND THE RIG TO BE SURE THAT IT IS CLEAR.

preguntaEn: IF THE SERVICE AIR LINE COMES APART WHILE YOU ARE DRIVING A COMBINATION VEHICLE BUT THE EMERGENCY LINE STAYS TOGETHER, WHAT WILL HAPPEN RIGHT AWAY?
opcionesEn: THE TRAILER’S TANK WILL EXHAUST THROUGH THE OPEN LINE.
THE EMERGENCY TRAILER BRAKES WILL COME ON.
NOTHING IS LIKELY TO HAPPEN UNTIL YOU TRY TO APPLY THE BRAKES.

preguntaEn: THE FRONT TRAILER SUPPORTS ARE UP AND THE TRAILER IS RESTING ON THE TRACTOR. MAKE SURE:
opcionesEn: THERE IS ENOUGH CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE UPPER AND LOWER FIFTH WHEEL.
THE SAFETY LATCH IS IN THE UNLOCKED POSITION.
THERE IS ENOUGH CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE TRACTOR FRAME AND THE LANDING GEAR.

preguntaEn: YOUR EMERGENCY AIR LINE BREAKS OR GETS PULLED APART WHILE YOU ARE DRIVING. THE LOSS OF PRESSURE WILL CAUSE THE:
opcionesEn: AIR COMPRESSOR TO UNLOAD INSTEAD OF PUMPING AIR.
TRACTOR’S AIR TO DUMP INTO THE TRAILER TANK THROUGH THE SERVICE LINE.
EMERGENCY TRAILER BRAKES TO COME ON.

preguntaEn: YOU HAVE A MAJOR LEAK IN THE SERVICE LINE AND YOU PUT ON THE BRAKES. SERVICE AIR WILL ESCAPE AND CAUSE THE:
opcionesEn: TRAILER EMERGENCY BRAKES TO COME ON.
TRAILER TANK PRESSURE TO BE LOST.
TRACTOR SPRING BRAKES TO LOCK ON.

preguntaEn: THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY CONTROL VALVE SHOULD AUTOMATICALLY CLOSE WHEN AIR PRESSURE FALLS TO BETWEEN _______PSI.
YOU HAVE CRASHED WITH ANOTHER VEHICLE. WHAT YOU HAVE TO DO FIRST?
opcionesEn: USE REVERSE GEAR TO BACK UP OFF THE CRASH.
TURN ON YOUR FOUR-WAY FLASHERS.
GET OUT OF YOUR VEHICLE AND AWAY FROM THE SCENE.

preguntaEn: YOU HAVE PUSHED IN THE TRAILER AIR SUPPLY VALVE. YOU SHOULD NOT BACK YOUR TRACTOR UNDER THE TRAILER UNTIL WHOLE AIR SYSTEM IS:
opcionesEn: EMPTY.
AT NORMAL PRESSURE.
BETWEEN 60 AND 80 PSI.

preguntaEn: THE FIFTH WHEEL LOCKING LEVER IS NOT LOCKED AFTER THE JAWS CLOSE AROUND THE KINGPIN. THIS MEANS THAT:
opcionesEn: THE TRAILER WILL NOT SWIVEL ON THE FIFTH WHEEL.
THE PARKING LOCK IS OFF AND YOU MAY DRIVE AWAY.
THE COUPLING IS NOT RIGHT AND SHOULD BE FIXED BEFORE DRIVING THE COUPLED UNIT.

preguntaEn: WHEN BACKING A TRACTOR UNDER A TRAILER YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: ALWAYS USE THE LOWEST REVERSE GEAR.
ALWAYS APPROACH THE TRAILER AT A SLIGHT ANGLE.
DO IT QUICKLY TO ENSURE THAT THE KINGPIN IS LOCKED INTO THE FIFTH WHEEL.

preguntaEn: IN NORMAL DRIVING, SOME DRIVERS USE THE HAND VALVE BEFORE THE BRAKE PEDAL TO PREVENT A JACKKNIFE. WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: IT SHOULD NOT BE DONE.
IT RESULTS IN LESS SKIDDING THAT USING THE BRAKE PEDAL ALONE.
IT IS THE BEST WAY TO BRAKE AND KEEP THE VEHICLE IN A STRAIGHT LINE.
